Name: Nyapu-Style Portraits for Cape Stardew Morrigan
Author: Adalghizar
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14635]Cape Stardew[/url] has a new character, Morrigan. Since there are Nyapu-style mods already for Annetta and Jelli, I figured she could use one, too!  This is my first attempt at a Nyapu-style portrait.

The file is in Content Patcher format, simply copy the file into your Mods file and you're done!


Recommended Nyapu-style portraits for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14635]Cape Stardew[/url]:

[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/SeaSea50]SeaSea50[/url]'s Nyapu-style [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25307]Annetta and Jelli[/url]

[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Aelinore]Aelinore[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18315]Nyapu-style Cape Stardew[/url]


Credits:
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/FallHarvester/mods]FallHarvester[/url] and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Lucidvisionsinc]Lucidvisionsinc[/url] for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14635]Cape Stardew mod [/url]and permission to upload.
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu]Nyapu[/url] for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]portrait assets[/url].
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister]Poltergeister[/url] for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]original Pirate Hat design used for Andy[/url].
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AhCuteArt]AhCuteArt[/url]﻿ for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26601]Nyapu-style Pirate Hat design[/url]﻿.
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AdarinSinner]Adarin[/url] for the Female Harvey design Morrigan's outfit was edited from.
